location: Tirisfal Glades, the ruins above the Undercity
entrance: Through the front gate of the ruins of Lordaeron, immediately to the left before the keep: the portal is up a flight of stairs, at /way 72.4 11.6.

95250.objective: Kill The Baron and bring his head to Captain Truman.
95250.note: Captain Truman waits near the entrance, on the brick path to the left. He is friendly to the Alliance and hostile to the Horde.

shots.alt: Captain Truman, an undead soldier with a lantern in a dark stone hall, his name in red above his head, a screenshot from the beta of World of Warcraft: Forever

95195.objective: Collect 10 Bloodied Insignias from the undead and take them to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind.
95195.note: The insignias start the quest; they drop from the undead throughout the dungeon.

95189.objective: Bring the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind.
95189.note: The crest has no fixed spot. Look on the floors of the buildings you pass.

92415.objective: Bring the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind.
92415.note: The letter lies near Rath'mael. The first of two steps; the chain ends with the Tarnished Locket. It cannot be shared.

97288.objective: Take the Abominable Head, a drop from The Baron, to the Undercity.
97288.note: The first of five steps with Master Apothecary Faranell: the body of Othmar, ingredients in the city and the Hissing Serum.

92401.objective: Find out what happened to Edward Heartweaver.
92401.note: His body lies in the graveyard next to Rath'mael.

shots.alt: The body of Edward Heartweaver in the graveyard near Rath'mael, a screenshot from the beta of World of Warcraft: Forever

95204.objective: Bring the Crest of Lordaeron to Oran Snakewrithe in the Undercity.
95204.note: The crest has no fixed spot. Look on the floors of the buildings you pass.

92421.objective: Collect 25 Intact Limbs from the Scourge in the dungeon for Morbin Lightbane in the Undercity.

95216.objective: Bring the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang to Theodore Griffs in the Undercity.

92422.objective: Kill Rath'mael for Deathguard Kristof in Brill.
92422.note: Kristof stands at the caravan between Brill and the Undercity.
